title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra
excerpt: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra, its next-generation flagship model positioned as a generational leap with state-of-the-art performance across computer use, web browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, and scientific research, alongside a dramatic jump on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark.
author: OpenAI

title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
excerpt: OpenAI discloses internal data on recursive self-improvement, showing how AI agents increasingly automate the research loop from idea generation to experiment execution, and announces that its automated research intern milestone has been reached.
author: OpenAI
coverAlt: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI article cover

title: Introducing Atlas, Our Omni World Model for Spatial Intelligence
excerpt: World Labs introduces Atlas, an omni world model pretrained natively on text, image, video, and 3D data with a multimodal autoregressive diffusion Transformer that fuses inputs into a unified spatial context, enabling camera-controlled generation, spatial reconstruction, spatiotemporal simulation, and image generation.
author: World Labs

title: Introducing Solaris
excerpt: Runway introduces Solaris, the first model in its Interface World Models series, which renders interfaces frame by frame in response to clicks, drags, and natural-language commands; built on Gen-4.5, it separates reasoning from real-time rendering and treats applications as living, interactive environments.
author: Runway

title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
excerpt: Google introduces Gemini 3.8 Flash, its strongest reasoning and coding model, alongside 3.8 Flash Cyber, a cybersecurity-defense variant with frontier vulnerability discovery and auto-patching, both with strengthened prompt-injection and safety defenses.
author: Tulsee Doshi and Raluca Ada Popa

title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
excerpt: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, two configurations of the same base model with different safeguard levels: Fable 5.1 for general use and Mythos 5.1 for trusted access in cybersecurity and life sciences, with gains across coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon tasks.
author: Anthropic
coverAlt: Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 article cover
